## What does ultra blend instant coffee mean for an Indian kitchen?

For decades, Indian households have reached for morning coffee without realizing what sits quietly at the bottom of the jar. Many commercial instant coffees dilute real beans with chicory root, masking the true flavor. When you pick up Ultra Blend instant coffee from Purity Beans, transparency takes center stage with a precise formulation of 70% coffee and 30% chicory. Unlike our 100% pure coffee variants, Ultra Blend delivers a smoother everyday cup with a lower caffeine profile, offering a comforting bridge for anyone transitioning away from heavy chicory brands. You get an honest brew without hidden surprises, priced accessibly at ₹209 for 50g and ₹309 for 100g. If you prefer a completely pure cup without chicory fillers, explore our 100% coffee options like Bold or Purista. Discover your daily ritual at https://p3online.in
